title: Three Winters and One Short Shed
subtitle: 能源利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 能源利用（人与自然·环境保护·能源与可再生）
meta: 主题语境：能源利用（人与自然·环境保护·能源与可再生）　|　核心词汇：fuel　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fuel 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the driver ① carried the fuel that no keeper in the shed would have weighed, and he said the carrying was the whole of the winter. The ② fuel, meaning the coal itself and not the fire, ran three winters and stayed unweighed in the book; fuel, he said, is the only thing in a shed that is judged by how long it is left unweighed.

Every ③ load of fuel in that shed had the same short sack beside it, and the ④ fuel at the far end, meaning the part they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only part anybody ever thanked twice. Fuel, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to weigh; the driver said the weighing is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fuel was the whole of the matter, meaning the stimulus and not the coal. The ⑥ fuel, meaning the stimulus and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody weighs; fuel, he said, is either something you carry or the only word that means both coal and a stimulus. He said the stimulus is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ fuel had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short sack. The ⑧ fuel of the whole thing, the driver wrote in January, was one shed and three winters of weighing; fuel, he said, is either the part at the far end or the reason you learned to weigh. He said the weighing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fuel I remember is the part weighed in the plan, which closed in 1972 and is still described as the quietest in the shed. ⑩ Fuel, my mother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being weighed; all fuel, she said, is a stimulus that has agreed to look like coal. She said the stimulus was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 燃料（指棚屋里每一堆旁边的那一堆）
B. n. 燃料（指那一批本身，与炉火相对）
C. 固定搭配：carry the fuel 运送燃料
D. n. 燃料（指留给孩子们的那一部分）
E. n. 燃料（抽象总称，指一间棚屋的备料之事）
F. n. 燃料（指计划里写到、被称过的那一部分）
G. n. 刺激因素；火上浇油的东西（add fuel to，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 刺激因素（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: carried the fuel that no keeper in the shed would have weighed
The fuel, meaning the coal itself and not the fire
Every load of fuel in that shed
the fuel at the far end
the fuel was the whole of the matter
the fuel had become a line in a plan
The fuel of the whole thing

answers.why: carry the fuel 意为“运送燃料”，1963 年那位司机运送了棚屋里没有一位看守人肯称过的燃料。
fuel 意为“燃料”，指那一批本身而不是炉火，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被称过。
fuel 意为“燃料”，指棚屋里每一堆旁边的那一堆，每一堆旁边都有同一只矮矮的口袋。
fuel 意为“燃料”，指留给孩子们的那一部分，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fuel 意为“刺激因素、火上浇油的东西”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这份刺激就是那件事的全部。
fuel 意为“刺激因素”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那批燃料，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
fuel 意为“燃料”，指计划里写到、被称过的那一部分，到 1970 年这一批成了计划里的一行。
fuel 意为“燃料”，司机一月写道，整件事的备料之事是一间棚屋和三个冬天的称过。
fuel 意为“燃料”，我记得的是计划里称过的那一部分，1972 年结束了，至今仍被说成棚屋里最安静的一部分。
fuel 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，燃料是唯一会因为被好好称过而变得更好的东西。
